# Overview

A tiny feel-good app: click to receive a short piece of advice to brighten your day. Built with Streamlit for a fast, simple web UI.

- **Stack:** Python · Streamlit  
- **Live demo:** <a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://apieceofadvice-hqxpokdvuz7hho29q7jezp.streamlit.app/" rel="noopener">Open the App</a>
